caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher or jug, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher features a wide, rounded body tapering to a narrower base, which sits atop a flat, circular foot. The foot and the rim of the pitcher are adorned with a beaded pattern. The top rim is undulating and includes a pronounced spout on the right. On the left side, there is a large, intricately curved handle, decorated with a zigzag pattern along its length and finishing with a spiral curl at the bottom. Below the pitcher, toward the right, the name "EUGENE LA FORET" is printed in uppercase letters. There are no other objects or decorative details on the background.
title: Silver Cream Pitcher
